name: Changing Jobs
overview: Scripture teaches that when considering a change in employment, believers are called to trust wholly in the Lord rather than their own understanding, acknowledging Him in every step so He may direct their paths. God promises guidance and instruction, as seen in Psalms where He is portrayed as a shepherd who provides and leads. Committing one’s work to the Lord brings stability and assurance, while avoiding ungodly influences ensures a righteous course. These truths encourage believers to seek divine counsel and commit their decisions to God when navigating job transitions.
